"""Freeze V167 all-case reductions,explicit support-bound checks and viewing."""
import ast
import shutil
from pathlib import Path
from train_directional_bank_trial import read,ref,save
repo=Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic');root=repo/'.cache/quality-20261107/V167-bounded-support-v1'
assert not (root/'train-result-v1.json').exists() and not (root/'scores-v1.json').exists()
scope=('All four fixed V167 endpoints;original/bounded-support heads have identical124909 parameters/47 tensors,data/init/loss weights/routing/optimizer. '
 'Only support mapping differs:original sigmoid versus quarter-floor shifted sigmoid,both initially.5. Both common fixed-support route/weight1/unit16,difference1/floor2/epsilon.003,anchor.25. '
 'Candidate floor is no assurance about delivered correction or noisy-flat safety. All89 prior neural files unchanged plus1new isolated variant. '
 'Exact V166 control. Historical contrasts mix interventions;adaptive related cohort,not independent scenes/significance. All cases and worst costs retained. '
 'Actual native viewing only after inspection;both protected scenes/priors/windows/JPEGs,ISO100 qualitative,notGT. Eight retained native columns.')
def names(s):
 return (s.replace('V166-common-support-routing-v2','V167-bounded-support-v1').replace('v166','v167')
  .replace('common-control','routed-control').replace('routed-common','bounded-support')
  .replace('Common ctrl raw','Routed ctrl raw').replace('Common ctrl EMA','Routed ctrl EMA')
  .replace('Routed common raw','Bounded support raw').replace('Routed common EMA','Bounded support EMA'))
sources=[]
for old in ['summarize-v166-final-v1.py','build-v166-tables-v1.py','paired-v166-regions-v1.py','quiet-dc-v166-final-v1.py',
 'record-v166-viewing-v1.py','route-v166-final-v1.py','compare-v166-retained-v1.py','review-v166-effects-v1.py']:
 s=names((repo/'.cache'/old).read_text())
 if old.startswith(('paired','record','compare','review')):
  prefix="        'scope':" if old.startswith('record') else "    'scope':"
  a=s.index(prefix);b=s.index('\n',a);s=s[:a]+prefix+repr(scope)+'})'+s[b:]
 if old.startswith('compare'):
  needle="    'V165':(repo/'.cache/quality-20261107/V165-pair-common-v1','pair-common'),";assert needle in s
  s=s.replace(needle,needle+"\n    'V166':(repo/'.cache/quality-20261107/V166-common-support-routing-v2','routed-common'),")
 if old.startswith('quiet-dc'):
  s=s.replace('v165-bounded-support-quiet-DC-audit-v1.json','v167-bounded-support-quiet-DC-audit-v1.json')
 p=repo/'.cache'/old.replace('v166','v167');assert not p.exists();ast.parse(s);p.write_text(s);sources.append(ref(p))
s=names((repo/'.cache/audit-v166-training-units-v1.py').read_text()).replace('through V165','through V166')
p=repo/'.cache/audit-v167-training-units-v1.py';assert not p.exists();ast.parse(s);p.write_text(s);sources.append(ref(p))
s=names((repo/'.cache/audit-v166-training-objective-v1.py').read_text())
needle="   assert 0<=c['support_mean']<=1 and np.isfinite(c['spectral_delta_RMS']) and c['spectral_delta_RMS']>=0";assert needle in s
s=s.replace(needle,needle+"\n   assert c['declared_support_floor']==arm['support_floor']\n   assert arm['support_floor']<=c['support_minimum']<=c['support_maximum']<=1")
s=s.replace('CPU/CUDA checks and4-call/eight-parameter-adjoint retained diagnostic','CPU/CUDA mapping/adjoint checks and56-root zero-floor compatibility replay')
p=repo/'.cache/audit-v167-training-objective-v1.py';assert not p.exists();ast.parse(s);p.write_text(s);sources.append(ref(p))
s=names((repo/'.cache/audit-v166-archived-support-v1.py').read_text())
needle="  groups[label,case['kind'],condition,case.get('cohort')].append(row)";assert needle in s
s=s.replace(needle,"  expected_floor=.25 if label.startswith('bounded-support-') else 0.\n  assert row['declared_support_floor']==expected_floor and expected_floor<=row['support_minimum']<=row['support_maximum']<=1\n"+needle)
needle="'cases_support_mean_below_1e4':int((values<1e-4).sum()),";assert needle in s
s=s.replace(needle,needle+"\n  'declared_support_floor':rows[0]['declared_support_floor'],'minimum_support_over_cases':min(v['support_minimum'] for v in rows),\n  'maximum_support_over_cases':max(v['support_maximum'] for v in rows),'cases_mean_within_1e4_of_floor':int((values<rows[0]['declared_support_floor']+1e-4).sum()),")
s=s.replace('A small gate alongside larger coefficient RMS suggests suppression but does not isolate training causality or measure a trained-path removal.',
 'Recorded min/max verifies configured support bound on every original forward. Support values and coefficient RMS do not establish delivered correction or quality;full maps were not retained.')
p=repo/'.cache/audit-v167-archived-support-v1.py';assert not p.exists();ast.parse(s);p.write_text(s);sources.append(ref(p))
assert len(sources)==11
snapshot=root/'protocol-document-v1.md';assert not snapshot.exists();shutil.copyfile(repo/'docs/bounded-spectral-support.md',snapshot)
receipt=root/'final-helper-preparation-v1.json';assert not receipt.exists()
save(receipt,{'status':'fixed-before-trained-quality','sources':sources,'protocol_snapshot':ref(snapshot),'scope':scope,
 'source':dict(ref(Path(__file__)),text=Path(__file__).read_text()),'new_forwards':0,'new_noise_draws':0})
output=repo/'docs/results/v167-final-helper-preparation-v1.json';assert not output.exists()
save(output,{'status':'fixed-before-trained-quality','preparation':ref(receipt),'source_texts':[dict(v,text=Path(v['path']).read_text()) for v in sources],
 'preparer':dict(ref(Path(__file__)),text=Path(__file__).read_text()),'expected_actual_objective_checks':2000,'expected_support_bound_training_records':2000,
 'expected_support_bound_review_records':3288,'expected_unit_records':1000,'expected_unit_fingerprints':2000,'inherited_mask_records':1000,
 'expected_current_paired_entries':3264,'expected_retained_versions':12,'expected_retained_paired_entries':43008,'expected_retained_mean_cells':3552,
 'expected_score_table_cells':205,'actual_native_viewing_required':True,'scope':scope,'new_forwards':0,'new_noise_draws':0})
print('Frozen11 V167 reductions/support-bound checks/view recorder;12 retained versions')
